title: FDE Integration And Recovery Lab
briefing: Implement the original receipt reducer and a fake external adapter in a local scratch project. No live APIs, credentials, payments or customer writes are needed. The reducer is a sequential model; record the extra requirements for a durable concurrent service. Completion is a self-reported evidence checklist.
objectives: Test scoped identity, replay and parameter conflict.
Expose a remote-success/response-loss failure using a fake adapter.
Separate local acceptance durability from remote-effect reconciliation.

prediction.prompt: Which boundary can still fail after a job and outbox are committed together?

options.label: Remote success before the worker records completion.

steps.title: Write the expected traces
steps.instructions: Before coding, list accepted A/k1, replay A/k1, conflict A/k1 with changed payload and accepted B/k1. State the final receipt count of two.

steps.title: Implement and mutate the reducer
steps.instructions: Copy or reimplement the lesson reducer, run its assertions, then remove tenant scoping and parameter comparison separately. Record which assertion fails for each mutation.

steps.title: Simulate an uncertain outcome
steps.instructions: Create a fake adapter that records an operation result, then raises a timeout on its first response. Retry with the original identity and reconcile the stored result; contrast a fresh identity that causes another fake effect.

steps.title: Trace storage boundaries
steps.instructions: Draw crashes before acceptance, after acceptance but before dispatch, and after remote success but before completion. For each, record the authoritative state, safe next action and what remains unknown.

steps.title: Write the recovery procedure
steps.instructions: Define retry limits, overall deadline, permission checks, receipt retention and manual review. State which requirements your in-memory model does not implement.

reflectionPrompts: What does your receipt prove, and what does it not prove?
Which concurrency or restart failure remains outside this lab?
extensionChallenge: Implement a disposable SQLite transaction with a unique tenant/request key, restart between acceptance and dispatch, and prove recovery. Keep all external effects behind the fake adapter.

evidenceChecklist.label: I ran tenant, replay and conflict assertions.
I demonstrated both intentional reducer mutations failing.
I traced remote success followed by response loss.
I separated durable acceptance from remote reconciliation.
